top_signals.title: Scraping the barrel: The gold rush in whisky cask investment schemes
top_signals.summary: Within the unregulated waters of whisky cask investment schemes, there be sharks. top_signals.title: Unbeaten 49ers edge Seahawks while Vikings stay perfect
top_signals.summary: Thirty-eight points — 21 by the Niners — scored off seven turnovers, four by Seattle, were the most in an NFL game since 2017.
